title: Two Women by Rose Bush, 1920s Black & White Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: END Front porch. beside me is Mary Reller, 1948 & Jean Bannister. July 1927 Father Maud Satchell Overaker
description: A 1927 outdoor snapshot capturing two women smiling near a large blooming rose bush and a shaded house porch. Both wear period-typical 1920s dresses and eyeglasses.
